shortDescription: Dune data showed that 23,080 tokens were deployed on Robinhood Chain on August 29, with Pons V2 accounting for 15,957, or about 69.1%, of the total. According to Odaily, Flap, Long, and Bankr deployed 2,109, 1,805, and 1,534 tokens, respectively, while Trenched.today deployed 833 tokens.
